target.primary: sign of exact full-census EOG 90th-percentile span change under ideal M release
secondary: sign of exact full-census EOG span under A release
target.releases: same A->B&M B->A&M M->A&B as existing parent
target.scaling: same original per-system median/MAD reference, no per-group refit

observation.name: at most one missed truly occupied grid cell
observation.generation: For each true world with occupied G, enumerate D=G and D=G without EACH single occupied cell. Other cells are treated as correctly observed nonoccupied except for the sole possible miss.
observation.feasibility: Candidate world G' must contain observed D, with popcount(G'\D)<=1. No false-positive observations.
observation.not: This is not unconstrained presence-only data, repeated-visit occupancy, Bernoulli detection modelling or actual empirical sampling.
observation.denominator: all generated unique (system_id,D) observation patterns, plus exact 129 true-G classes. Report world×observation cases separately but never as independent observations.

assays.one: one ideal noiseless local Boolean measurement of A/B/M at one row-major grid site; cannot query true G directly
assays.adaptive: select axis,node using only compatible candidate A/B/M masks and model-predicted target signs; observe hidden truth bit after selection
assays.primary_policy: target-aware greedy maximising pairs of distinct candidate mask triples with discordant response sign separated by query bit, tie A<B<M then ascending node
controls: 16 deterministic SHA-256 ranked target-blind generic policies with seeds 20261107..20261122
assays.weighting: no probability weights; duplicate A/B/M mask triples collapse for selection, preserve parameter labels as descriptive counts
assays.stop: stop when sign unanimous or no variable informative site; record unresolved even if algorithm exhausted budget

analyses.per_observation: for each (system_id,D), enumerate all consistent true mask triples and simulate every possible truth branch at budgets0..3; report unanimity over all possible truth branches
analyses.per_true_G: robustness defined as every valid D generated from that exact G leading to target-sign identification for all compatible worlds at a given budget; report how many of 129 true-G classes satisfy this
analyses.baseline: under perfect current G and same target, verify historical M-release 121/129 zero-assay identified; do not silently replace by broader observed-D denominator
analyses.secondary: A/B zero-assay identification under at-most-one-miss and two-assay descriptive results, keep same budget/policies
analyses.comparisons: report all fibres, 16 baseline seeds as bounded sensitivity range; do not claim statistical uncertainty or prediction

gates: 12 source landscapes, 768 parameter worlds and 129 exact G equivalence classes
for each true G, both D=G and every one-cell deletion generated
truth G remains in candidates for every D derived from it
feasible candidate sets exactly represent <=1 miss and zero false positives
no queries of hidden true mask before site choice
posterior candidate-set nesting, no lost identification
perfect-current-G baseline sign classification matches parent
limitations: known finite constructed landscapes, previously exposed
assumes exact map except <=1 false-negative occupied cell, not general presence-only data
assumes perfect local A/B/M measurements despite occupancy miss
full-census geometry and static release not dynamic biological scenarios
no prior probabilities, no natural ecological frequencies, no new EOG-WF endpoint
no policy guarantees for unmodelled mechanisms or realistic survey effort
